question: Who conveyed the teaching to the earth-moving yoginīs described as good eaters?
premises: They are described as good eaters
inference: An earth-moving yoginī transmitted the teaching to the earth-moving yoginīs
uncertainties: The epithet subhakṣāṇāṃ may have a technical ritual sense
plain_english: O beloved, it was told to the earth-moving, good-eating yoginīs by an earth-mover.
